records.name: Indian School of Business
records.description: Indian School of Business (ISB) in Hyderabad is India's premier one-year MBA (PGP) institution, established in 2001, and consistently ranked as India's top business school globally with a rank in the top 30 of the Financial Times global MBA ranking. ISB's faculty includes distinguished professors from Wharton, Kellogg, and London Business School, offering a rigorous international-standard business education. The school's strong alumni network, international academic partnerships, and industry connections make it the top destination for experienced professionals seeking an MBA.

records.name: International Institute of Information Technology Bangalore
records.description: International Institute of Information Technology Bangalore (IIIT-B) is a not-for-profit deemed university established in 1999, specializing in IT education and research with a strong emphasis on industry collaboration and applied research. It offers M.Tech., integrated M.Tech., and Ph.D. programs in areas including data science, AI, networking, and cyber security. IIIT-B has strong corporate partnerships with global IT companies and a robust startup ecosystem, consistently placing graduates in top technology firms.

records.name: Kerala Blockchain Academy
records.description: Kerala Blockchain Academy (KBA) in Thiruvananthapuram is India's first public sector blockchain training and research institution, supported by Kerala Digital University and the Government of Kerala. It offers professional certification, diploma, and training programs in blockchain development, DeFi, and distributed ledger technology for government employees, industry professionals, and students. KBA has trained thousands of blockchain professionals and is a key institution in Kerala's ambition to become a global blockchain hub.

records.name: International College of Financial Planning
records.description: International College of Financial Planning (ICoFP) in New Delhi is a specialized institution for financial planning and wealth management education, the first institution in India to offer programs aligned with the Certified Financial Planner (CFP) designation. It offers MBA in Financial Planning, B.Com (Financial Planning), and PGPFM programs preparing students for careers in financial advisory, wealth management, and investment planning. ICoFP has strong industry linkages with leading banks, insurance companies, and wealth management firms for placements.

records.name: Thadomal Shahani Centre for Management
records.description: Thadomal Shahani Centre for Management in Mumbai is a well-known management and business administration institute affiliated with the University of Mumbai, offering MMS and PGDM programs. It is known for strong industry connections in Mumbai's business community and provides practical management education with focus on marketing, finance, and HR. The institute offers good placement support for graduates seeking careers in Mumbai's diverse corporate sector.

records.name: Pune Institute of Business Management
records.description: Pune Institute of Business Management (PIBM) is a highly regarded private business school in Pune offering PGDM programs with strong emphasis on industry immersion, live projects, and corporate mentoring. PIBM maintains consistent placement records with leading companies in FMCG, banking, IT, and manufacturing. The institute is known for its management games, simulations, and industry speaker series that provide students practical exposure from day one.

records.name: Symbiosis School of Sports Sciences
records.description: Symbiosis School of Sports Sciences (SSSS) in Pune is a specialized institution under Symbiosis International University offering undergraduate and postgraduate programs in sports sciences, sports management, and physical education. The school integrates academic rigor with practical sports training, taking advantage of Symbiosis's extensive sports infrastructure. SSSS caters to a growing demand for sports management professionals, fitness scientists, and sports psychologists in India's rapidly developing sports sector.

records.name: National Academy of Sports Management
records.description: National Academy of Sports Management (NASM) in Mumbai is a specialized institution offering postgraduate and professional programs in sports management, sports marketing, and event management. It provides practical training for sports administrators, managers, and marketers serving IPL franchises, sports federations, and sports marketing agencies. NASM has faculty from the corporate sports world and places graduates in positions with sports bodies, media companies, and fitness industry organizations.

records.name: International Institute of Sports Management (IISM)
records.description: International Institute of Sports Management (IISM) in Mumbai is India's first dedicated sports management institute, offering PGDM and MBA programs in sports management. IISM has placed thousands of graduates in roles with cricket boards, football clubs, sports brands like Nike and Adidas, and sports media companies. The institute is known for its close relationships with the BCCI, ISL clubs, and other Indian sports organizations that offer students internship and placement opportunities.

records.name: K.J. Somaiya Institute of Management
records.description: K.J. Somaiya Institute of Management in Mumbai is a highly ranked private business school offering MBA (MMS), PGDM, and executive programs with strong specializations in finance, marketing, and business analytics. It is consistently ranked among the top 20 business schools in India and benefits from its Mumbai location for industry exposure and placements. K.J. Somaiya's alumni network spans BFSI, consulting, FMCG, and technology sectors across India.
